local_evidence.broker_protocol: disposable PostgreSQL plus exact-origin HTTP mock transport
local_evidence.broker_order_evidence: matching acknowledgement plus independent status readback
local_evidence.provider_order_states: verified full fill, partial/open fill and cancelled readback are represented without treating HTTP 2xx as execution proof
local_evidence.idempotency: same client order intent returns one persisted broker record without a second request; concurrent identical first-use requests produce one provider submission
local_evidence.paper_isolation: default PAPER mode cannot invoke market-data or broker connectors and supports immediate full-fill-or-reject market simulation only
local_evidence.kill_switch: blocks before account, quote or order network access
local_evidence.generic_bypass: broker writes denied without the finance gateway capability assertion

external_requirements: owner-selected licensed market-data provider and account
owner-selected broker sandbox or live account and API approval
exact provider origins and paths added to the production egress allowlist
encrypted OAuth/API credential configuration with minimum scopes
broker KYC/account permissions and valid MFA/OTP/session
owner risk limits, allowed instruments/venues and explicit live authorization
provider-side bounded smoke evidence; no real-money order is authorized by this report
